description.zh: 子账号的阿里云账号UID，【parentUserId，childUserId，RelationType】  或者【relationId】必须填写一组
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used as the member. You must set the RelationId parameter or all of the ParentUserId, ChildUserId, and RelationType parameters.

description.zh: 主账号的阿里云UID，【parentUserId，childUserId，RelationType】  或者【relationId】必须填写一组
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used as the management account. You must set the RelationId parameter or all of the ParentUserId, ChildUserId, and RelationType parameters.

description.zh: 账号关联id，【parentUserId，childUserId，RelationType】  或者【relationId】必须填写一组
description.en: The ID of the financial relationship between the management account and the member. You must set the RelationId parameter or all of the ParentUserId, ChildUserId, and RelationType parameters.
The type of the financial relationship. Set the value to enterprise_group.

description.zh: 请求唯一标识，用于标记一次请求，便于定位问题
description.en: The unique ID of the request. The ID is used to mark a request and troubleshoot a problem.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi relieve-account-relation --relation-type enterprise_group --parent-user-id 1738376485192612 --child-user-id 1512996702208737 --request-id request_id --relation-id 1 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
